modelDescriptions.whisperTiny: Small download and fast inference for limited hardware; lower accuracy on difficult recordings.
modelDescriptions.whisperSmall: Default choice balancing size, speed and accuracy.
modelDescriptions.whisperLargeV3: Higher accuracy, about 3 GB download; requires more memory and is slower on CPU.
modelDescriptions.qwen3Embedding: Required for local knowledge retrieval. Fixed 1,024-dimensional vectors; changing the model would invalidate the index.
modelDescriptions.mossNano: Recommended small model. Chinese/English preset voices and reference cloning, 48 kHz output at normal speed; works on CPU.
modelDescriptions.voxCpm2: Optional quality cloning and voice design. About 5 GB download and at least 32 GiB memory; uses an available supported GPU within its memory budget.
modelDescriptions.voxCpm2Q8: Recommended quality model for cloning and voice design. Quantized weights download about 3 GB and use less disk space than Full; the current availability budget remains 32 GiB physical memory, with a supported GPU preferred when capacity allows.
modelDescriptions.qwen3Aligner: Optional precise timing for an existing transcript. Limited to selected ranges of up to five minutes.
modelDescriptions.qwen3AlignerQ8: Smaller Q8 model for precise transcript timing. Native GPU acceleration is selected when available; up to five minutes per request.
modelDescriptions.sherpaDiarization: Compact speaker identification, about 41 MB. Automatic or exact speaker count; no account token.
modelDescriptions.spleeter2Stems: Fast two-stem vocals/accompaniment separation on CPU. Up to ten minutes per source; audition before accepting a background.
modelDescriptions.u2netp: Compact CPU background removal. Small download suited to ordinary images; output quality depends on the source.
modelDescriptions.u2net: Full background-removal model, about 176 MB. Uses more memory and processing time than Compact; suitable for more detailed foregrounds.
modelDescriptions.sherpaDiarizationFull: Full-precision speaker segmentation with ERes2Net, about 46 MB. Uses the same automatic or exact speaker-count workflow; no account token.
modelDescriptions.spleeter2StemsFull: Full precision two-stem vocals/accompaniment separation on CPU. Downloads twice the model data; uses the same ten-minute timeline and audition workflow.

localModels.selectedVoiceModel: Default for new reference voices; saved voices keep their model.
